_meta.source: TCVN 11823-3:2017 - Thiet ke cau duong bo - Phan 3: Tuong chan va tuong chuyen tiep
_meta.rule: All pressures in kN/m2, angles in degrees

where.theta: wall inclination from horizontal (90 for vertical wall)
where.delta: interface friction angle between soil and wall

active_rankine.condition: vertical wall, horizontal backfill, no friction (delta=0, beta=0, theta=90)

passive_rankine.condition: vertical wall, horizontal fill, no friction

passive_cohesive.formula: pp = kp * gamma * z + 2 * c * sqrt(kp)

where.ks: ka or k0 depending on wall type

where.heq: equivalent height of fill for live load [m] — from Bang 22/23

bang20_interface_friction.description: Delta (interface friction angle) between precast concrete pile/wall and soil
bang20_interface_friction.note: Values in degrees. Use for Coulomb ka calculation.

bang22_heq_abutment.description: Equivalent fill height heq [m] for abutment walls under live load (Bang 22)
bang22_heq_abutment.note: Use interpolation for intermediate pile lengths

bang23_heq_retaining.description: Equivalent fill height heq [m] for retaining walls under live load (Bang 23)

pressure_profile_sign_convention.net_pressure: passive - active (positive = net toward active side)
